'''Cynerus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was one of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] top [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] during the [[Galactic War]], with forty-nine confirmed kills of Republic officials. Keenly intelligent and physically impressive, Cynerus was committed to developing new ways to kill, and was tasked with the assassination of the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR" />
